searches.reason: Develop paired sequence interventions that distinguish reliance on recent, repeated interests from stale or isolated interactions. Measure changes in candidate ranks after truncation, masking, or shuffling, using matched random perturbations as controls. These probes can identify temporal failure modes without claiming to observe current purchase intent.

searches.reason: Build evidence-grounded probes for unsupported prerequisites, possible durable-item duplication, and specific content matches using only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions. Seek methods that distinguish supported matches, explicit contradictions, and insufficient evidence; calibrate these distinctions against available qualitative feedback without inventing compatibility facts or treating uncertainty as dislike.
